input.content: Pattern: input-normalization edit silently downgrades resilience wrapper. When a change adds argument normalization (e.g. key.strip()) at a call site that delegates to a retrying method (read_resilient), check the delegate is unchanged — the edit may swap it for the single-attempt primitive (read_once), dropping the retry contract. Tests rewritten alongside can enshrine the regression (asserting TransientRead propagates after one attempt). Review check: diff the called method, not just the argument; require a test where a transient failure is followed by success, plus an exhausted-retries test and a permanent-error-no-retry test.
